title: hexmesh validation results
description: validation/<case>/results.json: every level's numbers at full precision, or rounded from RESULTS.md where the run's own output is lost (task 0093; validation/tools/results.py).  No fields: nothing per cell.

nang.description: a hexmesh level's section counts (task 0098): divisions per quadrant arc

nrad.description: the core's O-H radial cells (0 on an H core)

nang_w.description: a rectangular core's divisions along each width edge

nang_h.description: a rectangular core's divisions along each height edge

environment.description: the run's versions; for rounded levels, those RESULTS.md names

extra.description: case-wide values that belong to no level
